subject: SysNovate pilot intake — technical onboarding availability and IT/security overlap
messages:
From: no-reply@redwood.ai
To: lina.park@sysnovate.com
Date: 2026-11-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Thanks for signing up — next steps for your demo

Hi Lina,

Thanks for starting a trial with Redwood Inference. Someone from our team will reach out shortly to schedule a 30–45 min technical walkthrough tailored to your environment. If you have required participants (AE, SE, IT/security), reply to this message and include their availability.

Quick checklist to help us prepare:
- Desired demo focus (latency, integrations, privacy)
- Expected user volumes
- Any compliance docs you want to review in advance

We’ll follow up with available slots across regions.

— Redwood Onboarding

Note: This is an automated confirmation.
From: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
To: lina.park@sysnovate.com
Cc: connor_obrien@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-20T10:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Thanks for signing up — scheduling a technical walkthrough

Hi Lina — welcome and thanks for signing up. I’m Jasmine from SDR; Connor (AE) and Grace (SE) are CC’d.

We’d like to schedule a 45-minute technical walkthrough where Grace will cover integration patterns and Connor will cover the pilot scope and success metrics. I understand you mentioned IT/security should be on the call — can you confirm who from infosec will join?

Proposed windows (in your local time, CET):
- Tue 24 Nov: 09:00–09:45 CET (AM slot)
- Tue 24 Nov: 15:30–16:15 CET (late afternoon)
- Wed 25 Nov: 08:30–09:15 CET (early morning)

If those don’t work, send 2–3 windows that do and we’ll align. I’ve included a short demo agenda and our IT checklist in case your infosec team wants pre-reading.

Attachments: Demo-Agenda.docx, SysNovate_IT_Checklist.pdf

Thanks — Jasmine
SDR, Redwood Inference
From: Lina Park <lina.park@sysnovate.com>
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
Cc: Marco Sanchez <marco.sanchez@sysnovate.com>, infosec@sysnovate.com
Date: 2026-11-20T17:46:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Re: scheduling a technical walkthrough

Hi Jasmine and team — thanks for the quick follow-up.

We can commit IT attendance for the pilot discussion but their morning hours are best (CET). Marco (CISO) plans to join if the slot is early. Proposed windows that work for us (CET):
- Wed 25 Nov: 08:30–09:15 CET (preferred)
- Tue 24 Nov: 09:00–09:45 CET (backup)

If you propose times in UTC or PST, please include the conversion — we’re a small security team and want to avoid confusion. Also, we’ll need a short call (10–15 min) after the walkthrough with infosec to go through the checklist and follow-up evidence request.

Thanks,
Lina Park
Head of Product Operations, SysNovate
From: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
To: lina.park@sysnovate.com
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, jasmine.liu@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-20T18:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Re: scheduling a technical walkthrough

Lina — thanks, that helps. Converting the preferred window:
- Wed 25 Nov 08:30–09:15 CET = Tue 24 Nov 23:30–00:15 PST / Wed 25 Nov 02:30–03:15 EST.

Two quick asks:
1) Grace — can you confirm SE availability to support a CET 08:30 slot (US west evening)? If not, we can take the Tue 09:00 CET backup which is Tue 24 Nov 00:00–00:45 PST.
2) Lina — would Marco and infosec be okay with the short follow-up (10–15 min) right after the demo or do you prefer a separate day? We can do a back-to-back 15-minute infosec sync.

I’ve attached our SOC2 excerpt and the checklist Jasmine sent to give Marco a head start. If the late PST hour is a blocker for Grace, we’ll switch to the 09:00 CET slot.

Attachments: SOC2-Type-II-Excerpt.pdf, SysNovate_IT_Checklist.pdf

— Connor O’Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai, jasmine.liu@redwood.ai, lina.park@sysnovate.com
Date: 2026-11-21T07:09:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Re: Re: scheduling a technical walkthrough

Connor — I can take the Wed 08:30 CET / Tue 23:30 PST slot but will need to hop off at the 30-min mark for another engagement. I can cover the core integration path and leave the last 15 min for Q&A with Marco/infosec. If you prefer full 45 min with uninterrupted SE time, pick the Tue 09:00 CET backup and I’ll shift my calendar (I can make the late-night backup work).

Also: during the call I’ll demo the KV cache and routing controls — Lina, if you have a specific integration (on-prem VPC or cloud peering), flag it now so I can prepare a short example.

— Grace
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Lina Park <lina.park@sysnovate.com>

Thanks all — the Wed 25 Nov 08:30 CET slot works for us and Marco can join for the full walkthrough; he prefers to be on for at least the first 30 minutes. A 15-minute follow-up infosec sync right after the demo would be perfect.

Please send a calendar invite (ET/UTC/PST conversions would be helpful) and Zoom link. Attaching our internal timezone policy for reference.

See you then — Lina
